blurb: Nestled in the heart of downtown Mountain City at Heritage Square, Heritage Hall Theatre stands as a beacon of cultural richness as the home for live entertainment in Johnson County, Tennessee. This intimate and inviting venue is not just a theatre; it’s a community hub where the arts flourish and thrive throughout the year.
